data.title: 洛茜 · 河边散步回头等你
data.description: 傍晚河边步道，洛茜穿奶油白蝴蝶结衬衫与酒红A字裙，走出两步又回头等你。她笑着伸出空手，肩上的小包和身后的狼尾随着转身轻轻摆动，落日照亮裙摆与棕色玛丽珍鞋。
data.action: 走出两步回身，伸出空手邀你同行
data.promptProse: Rossy walks two steps down the riverside path, then turns back smiling and offers an empty hand to her companion. Her cream ribbon-collar blouse, wine-red A-line skirt and short cocoa cardigan remain fully framed with brown Mary Jane shoes. Her bag and wolf tail swing with the turn. Golden sunset reflected from the river touches the skirt hem and shoes, while the path recedes into softer evening shade.
